package.description: A multithreaded batch image processor for Windows.

en-US.description: A multithreaded batch image processor for Windows.
en-US.longDescription: ImBatch is a free multithreaded image processing tool for your Windows PC. With the help of ImBatch, users can perform a variety of complex image editing tasks; applying those changes to hundreds of images at once. Whether you’re looking to crop, resize, rotate, add/remove tags or convert image format, ImBatch provides users with dozens of editing tools.
en-US.name: ImBatch

zh-CN.description: 一款适用于 Windows 的多线程批处理图像处理器。
zh-CN.longDescription: ImBatch 是一款适用于 Windows PC 的免费多线程图像处理工具。有了 ImBatch，用户可以执行各种复杂的图像编辑任务，并将这些更改同时应用到数百张图像中。从裁剪、缩放、旋转、添加/删除标签到转换图像格式，ImBatch 为用户提供数十种编辑工具。
zh-CN.name: ImBatch
